items.title: Samuel Sekuritas Denies It Pumped Stock, Took Part in MSCI Trade
items.summary: PT Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia and its owner, Eunice Satyono, denied that the firm carried out any illegal stock market transactions to spark the sudden rally in an Asian delicacy maker named PT Abadi Lestari Indonesia.

items.title: RBA Raised Rates as Price Risks Remained to Upside, Minutes Show
items.summary: A majority of the Australian central bank’s nine-member board voted to raise interest rates two weeks ago on concerns that risks to the inflation outlook remained to the upside and consumer prices had stayed too high for too long.

items.title: Chip Stocks Slide as US Sets New Curbs on China’s Compute Access
items.summary: Chipmaker stocks tumbled after the US moved to further restrict China’s access to advanced artificial intelligence chips and servers in the wake of the scandal involving Nvidia Corp.

items.title: China’s Buyback Push Struggles to Put a Floor Under Stocks
items.summary: Chinese companies are tapping only a fraction of loans provided by Beijing for stock buybacks, an indication that the latest effort to support markets is faltering.

items.title: Tech Under Pressure Ahead of Anthropic IPO, Stock Selloff Continues
items.summary: Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Alger’s Executive Vice President, Portfolio Manager Ankur Crawford, Bilt’s CEO Ankur Jain, Jefferies’ Senior Equity Research Analyst Sheila Kahyaoglu, Betterment’s CEO Sarah Levy, Citi Wealth’s Head of Portfolio Strategy J.P.

items.title: Gold Steadies Near 14-Month Low as Inflation Pressure Persists
items.summary: Gold steadied after its lowest close since September 2025, under pressure from stubborn US inflation and losses on Wall Street.

items.title: Shamrock’s Lasalle: Different Ways To Invest in Sports
items.summary: Mike LaSalle, co-president and partner at Shamrock Capital, says the firm is assessing how upcoming sports contracts and shifting cash flows could create investment opportunities. Jason Sklar, partner at Shamrock Capital, talks about the financial shortages emerging in the sports industry and the role Shamrock Capital plays. They speak with Romaine Bostick on "The Close". (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Alzheimer's Will Be a "Treatable Condition," Says David Cameron
items.summary: David Cameron says that we have reached a "tipping point" where the combination of new Alzheimer's treatments and new biotech and pharmaceutical companies could result in someone alive today having their Alzheimer's condition 'reversed.' He speaks at a Bloomberg.com subscriber event in London. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: AirAsia, Malaysia Airports in $122 Million Debt Repayment Talks
items.summary: Malaysia Airports Holdings Bhd. is in talks with AirAsia Group Bhd. about a repayment plan for 500 million ringgit ($122 million) owed by the low-cost airline, according to the airport operator.

items.title: Colombia’s De La Espriella Vows Spending Cuts in Investor Pitch
items.summary: Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella pledged spending cuts and fiscal discipline as he sought to reassure investors amid one of the country’s most severe fiscal crises in decades.

items.title: Betterment CEO Sarah Levy on Plus Debut, New IRA Options
items.summary: Betterment CEO Sarah Levy discusses the company's newly announced Betterment Plus program, which brings together human guidance, individual stock trading, lending and partner products, and IRA custody. She speaks with Romaine Bostick and Vonnie Quinn on "The Close". (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Learfield’s Cole Gahagan on Economics of College Sports
items.summary: Cole Gahagan, president and CEO of Learfield, discusses how the company helps colleges generate commercial revenue and connect student-athletes with name, image and likeness (NIL) opportunities. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close". (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Bilt CEO on the Launch of “Neighborhood OS”
items.summary: Ankur Jain, CEO of Bilt, describes the company’s expansion from building services for residents to helping neighborhood businesses attract customers. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close". (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Brandon Copeland: Tale of Two Cities in College Sports
